DISCHARGE SUMMARY — SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL
Patient: Jordan A. (SYNTH-001)   MRN: 000-SYN-001
Admit: 2026-03-02   Discharge: 2026-03-06

Dx: Community-acquired pneumonia, RLL.
HPI: 54 y/o pt presented w/ 4d productive cough, febrile to 38.9C, pleuritic chest
pain, SOB on exertion. CXR confirmed RLL consolidation. WBC 14.2. SpO2 92% RA on
admission.
Hospital course: Started on IV ceftriaxone + azithromycin. Afebrile x48h prior to
d/c. SpO2 improved to 97% RA. Tolerating PO. Ambulating independently.
Discharge meds: PO amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 BID x5d. Continue home
lisinopril 10mg daily.
Discharge condition: Stable, afebrile.
Follow-up: PCP in 7d. Repeat CXR in ~4-6 wks to confirm resolution. RTC/ED if
worsening dyspnea, fever >38.5C, or hemoptysis.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY — SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL
Patient: Priya S. (SYNTH-002)   MRN: 000-SYN-002
Admit: 2026-05-11   Discharge: 2026-05-13

Dx: Acute appendicitis, s/p laparoscopic appendectomy.
HPI: 29 y/o pt w/ 18h RLQ pain, anorexia, low-grade fever. CT abd/pelvis: dilated
appendix w/ periappendiceal fat stranding, no perforation. Taken to OR same day.
Procedure: Laparoscopic appendectomy, uncomplicated. EBL minimal. Appendix sent to
path (pending at d/c).
Post-op course: Advanced to regular diet, tolerated. Pain controlled on PO
analgesia. Ambulating. Voiding spontaneously. No fever post-op.
Discharge meds: Acetaminophen 500mg PO q6h PRN. Ibuprofen 400mg PO q8h PRN. Hold
NSAIDs if GI upset.
Activity: No heavy lifting >10 lbs x2 wks. May shower; keep incisions clean/dry.
Follow-up: Surgery clinic in 10-14d for wound check + path results. RTC/ED for
fever >38.5C, worsening abd pain, redness/drainage at incision sites, or
intractable vomiting.
